details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:265-289 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: When any rejection occurs, the reconcile function quarantines all created top-level paths but restores none of the legitimate paths.
  WHY: A model producing legitimate work alongside a rejected artifact loses the legitimate work; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed this as intended secure behavior.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:291-301 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: changed_paths includes paths moved to quarantine and no longer present at their original locations.
  WHY: Downstream consumers can receive a touched-set inconsistent with the workspace and may error or behave inconsistently; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed the impact because check_resolver_diff.sh skips non-existent paths.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:67-77; scripts/trusted_git_write.sh:78-89 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Validator helpers silently fall back to credentialless isolated Python without the systemd sandbox when the sandbox helper is unavailable.
  WHY: The fallback loses systemd network, resource, and filesystem isolation and can weaken the intended trust boundary; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed this because env -i and -I -S remain in place.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:243-263; _move_to_quarantine at 213-221 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Deleted rejected paths are reported as quarantined even though _move_to_quarantine does not move missing files.
  WHY: Legitimately deleting a previously planted rejected file can still produce a blocked exit and force a retry.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:134-148; 85-110 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: If both git metadata lookups fail, inventory traversal enters .git/ and hashes the entire Git object tree.
  WHY: A broken or unavailable Git metadata path can cause excessive CPU and memory use during workspace inventory.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:65-82 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: An empty _git_metadata_paths result allows inventory traversal to hash .git/ recursively.
  WHY: A non-repo or transiently corrupt .git directory can make every snapshot process a large object database.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:20609-20623 | severity=high | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: A review-blocked judge-loop snapshot failure breaks the loop and leaves an empty touched-path file.
  WHY: The authorization check can then pass vacuously while ignored artifacts remain undetected.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:280-289 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Rejection attribution skips descendants of created roots and reports only the top-level created directory.
  WHY: Operator-facing rejection reports do not identify the specific rejected descendant, weakening forensic attribution.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:269 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The reconcile function moves every created root to quarantine and then moves legitimate files back.
  WHY: The unnecessary round trips increase filesystem work and create a window in which legitimate files are absent.

- scripts/untrusted_process_sandbox.sh:314-323 | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Test-mode execution changes the validator working directory to the sandbox runtime directory.
  WHY: Future validator callers using relative paths can silently read or write relative to the runtime directory instead of the workspace.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py:253-262 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Python-startup rejection checks only the basename, allowing deeper malicious files to evade precise rejection or partial restoration.
  WHY: A malicious .pth or sitecustomize.py nested under a quarantined directory can interact with the created-root restoration behavior.

- scripts/check_resolver_diff.sh:170-180 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The touched-path loop can attempt syntax or JSON validation for paths listed after quarantine.
  WHY: Resolver or fix validation can abort on paths that the guard moved away; qwen_qwen3_7-plus disputed related downstream impact because an existence guard skips missing paths.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Detect ignored and hidden filesystem changes, quarantine unauthorized artifacts, and preserve authorized new files."
  expected_change_site: scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, the reconcile function (lines 265-289)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The restoration loop runs only when rejected is empty; scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, the restoration branch in the else clause, has no selective restoration for non-rejected created roots.

- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line."
  expected_change_site: scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh:55-78 (`run_implement_validator_python`) and scripts/trusted_git_write.sh:74-90 (`run_trusted_validator_python`)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: Both validator helpers retain an unsandboxed env -i ... python3 -I -S fallback when the sandbox helper is unavailable; no test pins the fallback out of existence.

- requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line."
  expected_change_site: .github/workflows/validate.yml (validate harness generation / discover / self-heal / fix-harness Codex steps)
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  EVIDENCE: `.github/workflows/validate.yml` is not in `pr_changed_files.txt`; its writer paths were not extended with the workspace guard, validator sandbox role, or `POST_AGENT_WORKSPACE_GUARD_EXPECTED_SHA256` anchor.

- requirement: "All `check_resolver_diff.sh` per-file syntax checks must not fail on quarantined paths."
  expected_change_site: scripts/check_resolver_diff.sh `while IFS= read -r touched` loop (lines 276-299)
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  EVIDENCE: The script iterates over every line of `--touched-set` and runs `py_compile` or JSON parsing; the reported `[ -e … ] || continue` guard does not address all quarantined-path cases.

=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, line or code reference: 265-289 (the reconcile function's created-roots handling) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When any artifact triggers rejection, the entire `else` branch at line 280 quarantines all created top-level paths and never selectively restores non-rejected ones.
  WHY: A model that produces both `src/fix.py` and a hidden `.tmp/sitecustomize.py` has both files quarantined, so legitimate work is permanently lost.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, line or code reference: 291-301 (changed_paths computation) | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `changed_paths` is the unfiltered set of all non-directory changes, including paths moved to quarantine.
  WHY: Consumers receive paths that no longer exist in the workspace and may treat the run as a no-op or mishandle those paths.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh, line or code reference: 67-77; scripts/trusted_git_write.sh, line or code reference: 78-89; scripts/review_commit_changes.sh, line or code reference: 74-83 | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: Validator Python helpers have inconsistent sandbox-fallback policies.
  WHY: Implement and trusted-write paths silently downgrade to a less-isolated execution mode while the review path fails closed.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, line or code reference: 243-263 (rejection classification) combined with _move_to_quarantine at 213-221 | severity=low | confidence=3
  PROBLEM: Deleted paths matching rejection criteria are appended to both `rejected` and `quarantined` although `_move_to_quarantine` returns without moving them.
  WHY: A model deleting a previously planted rejected file receives exit 20 and cannot self-clean the workspace.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, line or code reference: 134-148 (_git_metadata_paths) combined with 85-110 (_inventory) | severity=low | confidence=2
  PROBLEM: If `_git_metadata_paths` returns an empty set, inventory traversal enters `.git/` and hashes the entire objects/pack tree.
  WHY: A linked-worktree or broken-Git condition can consume substantial CPU and memory.

- Requirement: "Detect ignored and hidden filesystem changes, quarantine unauthorized artifacts, and preserve authorized new files." Expected change site: scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, the `reconcile` function (lines 265-289). Evidence of absence: There is no code to selectively restore non-rejected created roots when rejected items are also present. | severity=critical | confidence=5

- Requirement: "Fix every instance of each finding's defect class across this project's changes, not only the cited line." Expected change site: scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh 67-77 and scripts/trusted_git_write.sh 83-87. Evidence of absence: Both retain an unsandboxed `env -i ... python3 -I -S "$@"` fallback when the sandbox helper is unavailable. | severity=high | confidence=4
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, lines 268-289 (reconcile function restoration branch) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: When a writer creates both legitimate files and unauthorized artifacts, the `else` branch never iterates `created_roots` to restore non-rejected ones.
  WHY: All `created_roots` were moved to quarantine and legitimate files are lost whenever any rejection occurs.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, lines 291-298 (`changed_paths` computation) plus downstream consumers | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `changed_paths` is built from all changes, including paths the same call quarantined.
  WHY: Downstream code may try to `git add`, `git hash-object`, `py_compile`, or otherwise reference paths that no longer exist.

- scripts/implement_commit_changes.sh, lines 73-77 (`run_implement_validator_python` fallback) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When `sandbox_helper` is not executable, the function silently falls back to unsandboxed Python.
  WHY: The fallback loses systemd network deny, credential scrub, and resource isolation.

- scripts/trusted_git_write.sh, lines 85-89 (`run_trusted_validator_python` fallback) | severity=high | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `trusted_git_write.sh` has the same silent fallback to unsandboxed Python.
  WHY: A missing sandbox helper at commit time lets an earlier-planted ignored `sitecustomize.py` execute during URL rewriting.

- scripts/post_agent_workspace_guard.py, lines 266-289 (quarantine-then-conditional-restore) | severity=critical | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: Lines 268-270 always move every `created_root` to quarantine, while restoration runs only in the no-rejection branch.
  WHY: Even a single rejected artifact discards all sibling legitimate work.

- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, lines 20609-20623 (review-blocked judge loop snapshot handling) |
